card.name: Digits in antiviral resistance mutation lists
card.fires_on: The digit 7 (or 3) inside amino-acid mutation codes such as L76V in lists of resistance substitutions. It also fires on the space before a number of days or weeks in antiviral treatment durations.

modes.label: Mutation codes
modes.description: A digit inside a resistance substitution code or a list of residue positions in an HIV or hepatitis C label.

modes.label: Treatment duration
modes.description: The space just before the number of days or weeks in a hepatitis C or COVID-19 regimen.
